newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT V INDIAN BOARD PRESIDENT'S XI.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS AND BAT V INDIAN BOARD PRESIDENT'S XI.

text.p: decided to bat in their rain-affected three-day match against
the Indian Board President's XI on Saturday.
The first two sessions were washed out due to a damp wicket
and water-logged outfield, but the umpires declared the ground
fit for play after four inspections, enabling two hours of play
to be extracted from the opening day.
Australia: Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Michael
Slater, Ricky Ponting, Steve Waugh, Michael Bevan, Ian Healy,
Paul Reiffel, Damien Fleming, Glen McGrath and Peter McIntyre.
Indian Board President's XI: Sanjay Manjrekar (captain),
Vikram Rathore, V.V.S. Laxman, Vinod Kambli, Pankaj Dharmani,
Saba Karim, Sunil Joshi, Aashish Kapoor, David Johnson, D.
